Name: Obadiah, Captain of Gad
Summary: Second captain of the Gadites who separated themselves to David in the wilderness.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:9: Second captain of the Gadites who separated themselves to David in the wilderness.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Obadiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
